answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via capacity-bounded web-of-trust vouching. Verified anchors sign finite cryptographic endorsements, extending trust like a jetty while max-flow checks isolate fake clusters. Attackers incur the scarce cost of securing limited endorsement slots and risking guarantor reputation per identity, blocking a gale of clones that mirror real agents. However, it hinders unconnected newcomers and fails if compromised anchors collude.
